name: Junks and Tanka boats by a river fort, Canton (Guangzhou)
summary: This drawing depicts the river fort known to the Chinese as the Haizhu ('Sea pearl') fort, and to Westerners (for obscure reasons) as the Dutch Folly Fort; it lay a little downstream from the site of the Western 'Hongs' or 'Factories' through which all Western trade with China was conducted at this
